name: Project Subtrahend
source:
You’ve been invited to join Project Subtrahend. What could possibly go wrong?

…As it turns out, quite a lot! 

In this choose-your-own-adventure visual novel, you’ll have the chance to get to know the stories, pasts, and personalities of nine peculiar characters after you've all been invited to help with an innocent social experiment. But things aren't all smooth sailing. 

When things start going awry, and when the true intentions of the experiment are revealed, your choices will determine the possible endings you can get. It’s up to you who makes it out alive...

Project Subtrahend also explores what it means to be human, and the value of human life, through the backstories and political situations of certain characters.  

With entertaining gameplay, secret endings, rewards for achievements, bonus scenes, and an hour of playtime in each route, you won’t be getting bored anytime soon as you discover everything Project Subtrahend has to offer!

[From [url=https://lilydynamite.itch.io/project-subtrahend]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已受邀加入Subtrahend项目。可能会出现什么问题？

……事实证明，相当多！

在这部你自己选择的冒险视觉小说中，在你被邀请帮助进行一项无辜的社会实验后，你将有机会了解九个独特角色的故事、过去和性格。但事情并非一帆风顺。

当事情开始出现问题，当实验的真实意图被揭露时，你的选择将决定你可能得到的结局。能活下来就看你了……

Subtrahend项目还通过某些人物的背景故事和政治情境来探索人类的意义以及人类生命的价值。

有趣的游戏玩法、秘密结局、成就奖励、奖励场景以及每条路线一小时的游戏时间，一旦你发现Project Subtrahend提供的一切，你就不会感到无聊！

[来自[url=https://lilydynamite.itch.io/project-subtrahend]Itch.io[/url]]
